name: Babylon Rooftop
lede: On the rooftop of Westfield Sydney, Babylon’s outdoor terrace and alfresco dining are warmed by 34 Platinum gas heaters in two sizes. Bromic worked with the architects on the heat, for an operator returning for a second venue.
data: Rooftop bar and restaurant – terrace and alfresco
beats: Babylon sits on the rooftop of Westfield Sydney: a Mantle Group restaurant and bar designed by Hogg & Lamb and built by Xenia, with an outdoor terrace and alfresco dining.
The open terrace and alfresco areas had to stay comfortable for diners through the cooler months.
Thirty-four Platinum Smart-Heat Gas heaters – 22 of the smaller size and 12 of the larger – warm the outdoor areas. Bromic worked with the architects on the heating.
team: Operator and project manager: Mantle Group
